decisionRule: NO_GO if one required condition is not PASS, one required evidence item is missing, or one hard external gate is unresolved.

externalGates.title: Verified Sejoli event, signature, retry, and order semantics
Verified WordPress one-time bridge and safe account linking
Approved Indonesian legal and privacy operating policy
Legacy commercial promises and exceptional access rules

gates.name: Access
gates.ownerRole: Commerce Owner + Engineering Lead + QA Lead
requiredConditions: Synthetic paid, refund, cancel, duplicate, and replay fixtures pass
Reconciliation queue and bounded manual recovery work
Revoking one grant source preserves another valid source
Identity mapping, RBAC, and effective-access explanation pass
gates.exitDecision: Access path may launch only for the provider evidence and scope actually tested.

gates.name: Learning
gates.ownerRole: Product Owner + Learning Operations + QA Lead
requiredConditions: Program, roadmap, resource, schedule, and recording mobile UAT pass
Progress rebuild returns the expected result
Expired access cannot retrieve protected learning assets
Critical learning states pass keyboard, focus, contrast, and zoom checks
gates.exitDecision: Learning scope may launch after owner UAT and provider/privacy evidence for the selected scope pass.

gates.name: SKD
gates.ownerRole: Academic Owner + Engineering Lead + QA Lead
requiredConditions: Academic owner signs the exact blueprint and scoring-policy versions
Golden scoring and result-correction fixtures pass
Offline, resume, device lease, expiry, and submit E2E pass
No answer secret appears in active-attempt payloads
Load test and exam incident drill pass
gates.exitDecision: Only the signed exam family/year/policy combination may activate; synthetic policy never qualifies.

gates.name: Commerce/Launch
gates.ownerRole: Launch Commander + Product Owner + Commerce Owner
requiredConditions: Branded checkout intent and return flow work without trusting client payment state
Flash-sale sales, attempt, result, explanation, and leaderboard windows are validated
Security, migration, reconciliation, restore, rollback, and support rehearsals pass
Monitoring, on-call, alert routes, rollback authority, and signed go/no-go are confirmed
gates.exitDecision: Only an explicit GO decision authorizes progressive production rollout.
